title: 一音目で払ってやる
subject: a first-year in a high-school competitive karuta club at the July tournament at Ōmi Jingū, sweeping cards across the tatami before the reader finishes the first syllable, against a smug third-year from a rival school who sneered at her
caption: Japanese para para Eurobeat in the Super Eurobeat tradition, the high-speed dance style Tokyo para para dancers move to. A four-on-the-floor kick with offbeat open hi-hats and a snare on two and four; a galloping octave synth bass in sixteenth notes; a bright brassy FM-synth lead playing the hook riff; orchestra-hit stabs closing each phrase; a sawtooth synth arpeggio running under the verses. Loud, compressed 2000s club mix, synths wide, vocal centered with a short delay. Female voice, strong high chest voice, racing and defiant in the verses and belting the chorus. 156 BPM, F minor. Breathless, defiant and funny. No dubstep drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap verse, no guitar solo.
lyrics:
[Intro - octave synth bass and brassy synth riff]

[Verse 1]
七月の近江神宮 広い畳
白い靴下で 正座する
向かいは他校の 三年生
「一年か」って 鼻で笑った

[Pre-Chorus]
暗記の十五分 にらみ返して
札の場所なら 全部入った

[Chorus]
一音目で 払ってやる
読手の「む」が 終わる前に
畳の上を 札が飛ぶ
あんたの陣まで 払ってやる

[Verse 2]
「すみのえの」は 「す」で取った
「せをはやみ」は あっちへ送る
三年の指は 空を切って
お手つきひとつ 耳まで赤い

[Pre-Chorus]
飛ばした札が 審判のひざ
「すみません」って 次 行くよ

[Chorus]
一音目で 払ってやる
最後は一枚 対 一枚
足がしびれて 立てなくても
畳の外まで 払ってやる

[Outro - synth riff and orchestra hits]
「一年か」って もう一回 言ってみな
